The closed-shell assignment for this near-linear terminal ligand is N≡[O+], with metal formal charge +0 and total charge +1. The authors' CIF identifies the PF₆ salt of the η⁶-anisole nickel nitrosyl. Anisole is neutral and the complex ion carries +1, Near-linear Ni(0)/NO⁺ is a formal representation consistent with the related nickel–arene series
